description: Find how a Hyperliquid market is named: perps (native and HIP-3), spot and live HIP-4 outcomes, with symbol, class, issuer, base asset and Hyperliquid coin. Search with q (q=nvda finds xyz:NVDA-PERP and the other NVDA perps). Pages of up to 100 rows; pass pagination.next_cursor as cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: pagination.next_cursor from the previous page, with the same filters

include_inactive.description: Also return closed markets (delisted, settled HIP-4 outcomes), which carry active_to_ms. Default false.

issuer.description: HIP-3 issuer code (e.g. 'xyz'). '' returns native markets only. Omit for every issuer.

market_class.description: Only this class. 'prediction' is HIP-4 outcomes. Omit for all.

q.description: Case-insensitive search over symbol, base asset, Hyperliquid coin and issuer

name: list_markets

active_to_ms.description: Close time, Unix milliseconds; only on closed markets (include_inactive)

base_market.description: Display symbol without the HIP-3 issuer prefix

issuer.description: HIP-3 builder code ("" for native markets)

matched.description: Markets matching the filters and search, across all pages

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same filters, for the next page; null on the last page

total.description: Markets matching the filters and search

title: List markets
